about: P68 T1: required actions per new game, frozen 2026-11-01 before the categories start. Every assertion reads the state trace (body positions and roles, inputs, outcome), never win/score effects a rule emits. 60 ticks = 1 s. Each game: the bot wins, the idle player and a weak bot lose, all within maxTicks.

stunt.expect: the player's vehicle body crosses the finish line before tick 5400 (90 s)
at least one jump: the vehicle is >= 0.5 m above the ground for >= 12 consecutive ticks
at least one crash moves or removes a debris body (debris bodies <= STUNT_DEBRIS_MAX = 24)

minigolf.expect: the ball comes to rest inside the hole zone
strokes = number of shot inputs in the trace, and strokes <= the course limit

railfps.expect: yawStep (game state slot RAILFPS_SLOTS.yawStep) takes >= 3 distinct values
a target body disappears within 30 ticks after a FIRE input while yawStep matches the target's step

buildshift.expect: the player builds >= 2 stations on grid cells
the resource count drops after a build
served customers reach the shift goal
a bot that builds badly loses

drawsave.expect: a stroke (cell-axis inputs under HOLD) creates wall bodies
the protected body survives to the end
without a stroke the protected body is lost
